summary: Complete reconnaissance report for the HackerRank Orchestrate October 2026 challenge. Covers: challenge summary, full repository map, exact input/output contract with all allowed operations and ordering rules, dataset scale and evidence inventory, existing implementation state (both code files are empty stubs), architecture assessment of the planned five-agent LangGraph approach, 14 identified risks and unresolved questions, and 9 proposed implementation milestones each with scope, tests, and dependencies.
